meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

meanings.note: neuter главное, used as a noun

meanings.en: hot (to the touch, of food/drink, not weather)

meanings.note: joins a description to a noun; agrees with that noun in gender and number

examples.trans: This is a mayor who keeps his word.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.

meanings.note: playful derogatory nickname used by Chef Barinov for Max

examples.trans: Runt, are you still standing here?

meanings.note: agrees in gender and case with the noun
с первого раза = the first time

meanings.note: serving tool with a deep bowl used for soup or liquids

понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?

meanings.note: formally admit into a brotherhood or dedicate work

examples.text: Шеф посвящает много времени обучению поваров.

meanings.note: ceremony marking induction into a group

examples.trans: The initiation ceremony will be remembered for a long time.

meanings.note: act of losing or state of being lost

examples.text: Москва снимет вас за потерю доверия.

принимать.gloss: to receive, to see (visitors); to take

examples.trans: The mayor isn't seeing anyone today.

meanings.note: act of acquiring something or something acquired
